person_note: The diagnostic Goodreads passages repeatedly expose Violet as a participating present-tense “I” narrator, and the authorized sustained excerpt independently confirms that voice. Whole-book structural sources report brief late chapters from Rhiannon, Imogen, and Xaden, but these are additional participating character narrators and therefore remain FIRST under the methodology rather than ALTERNATING. Pure speech, dedication material, and boundary-damaged snippets were not allowed to vote. The principal limitation is that the Tier A prose has opening/section rather than whole-book scope, but the Tier B/C structural coverage resolves the late POV changes with no evidence of sustained second- or third-person narration.
